upgrade_gate/NOTES.md.content:
The gate replays every SQL-agent recipe on the candidate tree and on the installed verl 0.9.1. For each recipe it resolves that tree's Hydra config from the launch script, then runs the tree's own advantage, rollout-correction, and FSDP update path on the recorded steps and on longer, unbalanced batches (tool-mask islands, truncated turns, uneven groups, importance-sampling outliers, and dynamic micro-batches across 2 data-parallel ranks).

It compares the advantages, corrected masks, importance weights, and the per-token updates those batches would apply, including off-policy probes for clipping, sequence-level ratios, value clipping, distillation, and entropy. A release that only moves code passes when those updates match up to float rounding.
